office_does: A Court of Appeals judge decides appeals from superior court cases; Division III's District 3 (Chelan, Douglas, Kittitas, Klickitat and Yakima counties) elects two of its five judges for six-year terms.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Megan K. Murphy, appointed to the court in January 2025, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Court of Appeals, Division III judge since her January 2025 appointment; former Yakima County deputy prosecutor and civil litigator; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Appointed to Division III in January 2025, replacing Judge Rebecca Pennell [S1][S2]
Yakima County deputy prosecutor for about five years from 2001, then civil litigation in private practice [S1][S2]
Partner at Fox Ballard in Seattle; earlier a Yakima practice in medical-malpractice defense [S2]
